edges.relation: Delay records are extreme events in the random walk model; their stopping times define the tail of the first-passage time distribution
The drift of the random walk IS the Lyapunov exponent; negative drift = negative lambda = convergent orbit
Lambda approaching 0 for delay records = approaching the critical point of the phase transition between convergent and divergent regimes
Phase transitions are analyzed via RG flow; the Collatz coarse-graining defines a natural RG transformation on residue classes
The entropy of the parity sequence determines the compressibility; sub-maximal entropy enables compressed reconstruction
The transition matrix deviations from i.i.d. Bernoulli quantify how much the deterministic Collatz dynamics deviates from the stochastic model
GA navigates the fitness landscape of Collatz delay; landscape ruggedness determines GA convergence rate
Delay records are 'fitness peaks' in the Collatz landscape; understanding landscape topology guides record search
Sieving by residue class mod 2^k IS the discretized RG flow; top sieve classes correspond to RG fixed-point neighborhoods
Sieved residue classes restrict the GA search space, dramatically improving efficiency by pruning low-delay regions
The fractal dimension of the inverse Collatz tree is a RG invariant; self-similarity of the tree reflects scale invariance at criticality
GPU parallelism enables exhaustive search up to 2^71, confirming convergence and discovering new path records in the process
Shannon entropy of parity sequence is determined by the odd-step fraction, which directly gives the Lyapunov exponent: lambda = f*ln(3) - ln(2)
The inverse Collatz tree IS the fitness landscape viewed as a phylogenetic tree; delay = evolutionary distance from the root organism (1)
The critical point lambda=0 is analogous to the 'error threshold' in quasispecies theory; beyond it, genetic information (convergence) is lost

bridge_chains.name: Random Walk to Phase Transition
bridge_chains.insight: The stochastic model's drift parameter IS the Lyapunov exponent, which IS the order parameter of a phase transition, which IS analyzed by RG flow. Four different domain perspectives on one quantity.

bridge_chains.name: Information to Dynamics
bridge_chains.insight: The parity entropy determines compressibility (signal processing), which quantifies deviation from the random model (physics), which gives the Lyapunov exponent (dynamics). Shannon entropy bridges all four domains.

bridge_chains.name: Evolution to Number Theory
bridge_chains.insight: GA explores the fitness landscape, whose topology is the fractal inverse tree, whose structure is determined by modular arithmetic. Biology provides the search strategy; math provides the structure.

bridge_chains.name: Computation to Criticality
bridge_chains.insight: GPU compute power finds delay records (HPC), which have extreme Lyapunov exponents (dynamics), which approach the critical point (physics). Computation reveals the deepest structure.
